question: Cual es la nacionalidad de Lewis Hamilton?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton' LIMIT 1

question: Cual es la fecha de nacimiento de Fernando Alonso?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT dob FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Fernando' AND surname = 'Alonso' LIMIT 1

question: Quien hizo la pole position en el Australian Grand Prix de 2008?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.position = 1 LIMIT 1

question: Cuantas victorias tiene Lewis Hamilton en la Formula 1?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_wins FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND res.position_order = 1

question: Que escuderia logro mas victorias en la temporada 2015?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS total_wins FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE r.year = 2015 AND res.position_order = 1 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_wins DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 1

question: Cuantas poles logro Lewis Hamilton en 2008?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_poles FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.position = 1

question: Cual fue el promedio de vueltas completadas en el Australian Grand Prix de 2008?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(laps)::numeric, 3) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008

question: Quien gano el Australian Grand Prix de 2008, con que escuderia y en que fecha fue?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.date FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND res.position_order = 1 LIMIT 1

question: Quien lideraba el campeonato de pilotos despues del Australian Grand Prix de 2008 y con cuantos puntos?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, ds.points, ds.wins FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND ds.position = 1 LIMIT 1

question: Que le paso a Kimi Raikkonen en el Australian Grand Prix de 2008?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, res.position, res.points, s.status FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id LEFT JOIN status s ON res.status_id = s.status_id WHERE d.driver_ref = 'raikkonen' AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 LIMIT 1

question: Quien gano el sprint del Sao Paulo Grand Prix 2021 y con que escuderia?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS winner, c.name AS constructor_name, r.date FROM sprint_results sr JOIN races r ON sr.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON sr.driver_id = d.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON sr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE r.name = 'São Paulo Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2021 AND sr.position_order = 1 LIMIT 1

question: Quien hizo la pole en el Australian Grand Prix de 2008 y en que posicion termino la carrera?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, q.position AS qualifying_position, res.position_order AS race_finish_position FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id JOIN results res ON res.race_id = q.race_id AND res.driver_id = q.driver_id WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.position = 1 LIMIT 1

question: Que pilotos sumaron puntos para Mercedes en el Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2021?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.points FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2021 AND c.name = 'Mercedes' AND res.points > 0 ORDER BY res.points DESC, driver_name ASC

question: Compara las victorias de los 10 pilotos con mas triunfos en la historia de la Formula 1

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT d.driver_id, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(res.result_id) AS total_wins FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE res.position_order = 1 GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY total_wins DESC, driver_name ASC LIMIT 10

question: Evolucion de las victorias de Lewis Hamilton por temporada

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT r.year AS season_year, COUNT(*) AS total_wins FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE d.driver_ref = 'hamilton' AND res.position_order = 1 GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year

question: Compara las victorias de las 10 escuderias con mas triunfos en la historia de la Formula 1

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(res.result_id) AS total_wins FROM results res JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE res.position_order = 1 GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_wins DESC, constructor_name ASC LIMIT 10

question: Compara los 10 circuitos con mas carreras disputadas en la historia de la Formula 1

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(*) AS total_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuit_id = c.circuit_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_races DESC, circuit_name ASC LIMIT 10
